alerts.text: The Sorceress is spent. Fallen Shaman ended her in Blood Moor.
Something glints in the dust: Harlequin Crest (unique).
The hero is back in Rogue Encampment and ready to trade.
Andariel has fallen. The hero stands over the remains.

outbound.consent: Outbound alerts are off. Nothing leaves this machine.

notifications.browser: Desktop notifications work while this tab is open; the browser asks for permission only when you press the button.
notifications.background: Background push (tab closed) needs a service worker and web push. It is not built.
